prerequisites: Basic knowledge of the structure and properties of materials.
General knowledge of the International System of Quantities (ISQ) and the International System of Units (SI).

learning_outcomes.text: Familiarize students with the principles of design, function and use of basic kinds of measuring tools in industrial practice.
Pay special attention to the practical needs of the metrological activities for quality control of production.
Acquire knowledge of basic measuring methods and devices that can be applied in individual technologies.
Learn to solve and implement practical metrology applications both in service and laboratory conditions.

syllabus_topics: Engineering metrology in the Czech Republic, in the EU and the World metrology systems
The statistical tools in metrology, calibration and verification of measuring instruments
Methods and equipment for length measurement
Methods and equipment for measuring surface texture parameters
Methods and equipment for angle and circular contours, bores and cones measurement
Methods and equipment for screw threads, gears parameters and parameters of geometric accuracy measurement
Methods and devices of pressure measurement
Methods and devices of temperature measurement
Methods and devices of material thicknesses measurement and measurement of level heights in reservoirs with solid and liquid substances
Measuring of nonelectric quantities, properties of sensors
Measuring of stress and strain using strain gauges
Derivation of fundamental stress problems – tension, compression, bending and torsion
Other electric sensors, overview of questions for the exam
Measurement of lengths I, Safety in the laboratory, requirements for reports
Measurement of lengths II
Statistical tools in metrology, measurement uncertainty
Measurement of surface roughness parameters
Calibration and verification of measuring instruments
Measurement of angle and circular contours, bores, cones, screw threads and gears parameters
Contact temperature measurement
Contactless temperature measurement
Thickness measurement and material identification by ultrasound
Measuring of biaxial state of stress and distance
Measuring of torque and pressure force
Measuring of bending moment and tensile force
Correction of elaborates and course-unit credits

assessment_methods.method: Active participation in computational assignment processing

assessment_rules: Course-unit credits are awarded based on attendance at seminars, correct elaboration of computational assignment, and active participation in its processing. The final exam consists of written and oral parts and is graded on the ECTS scale. Attendance at exercises is compulsory, and missed lessons can be replaced or compensated with a supplemental task.
institution: WYSOKÉ UCENI TECHNICKÉ V BRNE - Brno University of Technology
